children: From the first launch to Apple Pay, bank notifications, debts, credits, FOP, brokers, investment taxes and your own ChatGPT or Claude. Short and step by step.

Install Dibsly from the App Store and tap «Get started» (the globe at the top changes the language). Dibsly asks for notifications and the AI — both can wait. Used Dibsly before? «Restore your data»: sign in, a backup or a CSV.

«Where does your money come from?»: monobank in one tap or any bank's statement (PDF, CSV or XLS), several if you like. Dibsly names the accounts itself on «Here are your accounts». No bank? «Start without a bank».
Then Main's «Set up the rest?» card shows what is left: the accounts, a backup and the automation that records spending itself —
An account is optional: you can sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail any time later.
— the big number at the top: your money for everyday life, cards and cash. Savings, investments and an account with Count in balance off are never in it.
The NBU rate is on the right of the On hand row; a tap opens the converter.
— one tile per currency; the Investments and FOP tiles appear when they are on. Moving money between your accounts is never spending or income.
— Income, Spent and Net; a tap opens their operations. Below: Activity with drafts, the Plan and the Calendar — each opens with All ›.
records an operation (an expense, income, a transfer or a debt), a phrase («Say it») or a receipt. The gear at the top opens Settings, with a search at the bottom.
— a block on Main: a short film for each feature, “Turn on” under it, swipe up for the next one. × hides it; Settings → Features → “Show on Main” brings it back.
The keypad opens first and can count + − × ÷. Then pick a category — tapping it saves the operation.
Tap the date at the top to change it; a future date isn't counted until it comes. After expense lets you type the balance you see in the bank, and the amount is worked out.
Your past notes are suggested as you type; picking one sets its category too.
A transfer moves money between your own accounts and is never spending. Between currencies, enter what arrived; the rate comes from Currencies.
In History, tap an operation to change it — changes save at once. Hold it to change the category, duplicate, select several or delete.

In an expense's card, «Split by category»: ₴1,000 at a café becomes 600 for food, 250 for drinks and 150 for a hookah, each part counted in its own category. The balance doesn't change, and the bank's later statement still recognises the whole payment. You can split before saving too — in the new expense's card and in an Apple Pay or bank notification draft, where «Split with…» for friends is as well.
Deleted something by mistake? «Undo» in the message after deleting brings back operations, transfers, goals and payments.
In History and Analytics the filter takes several accounts and several categories at once: tick them and tap «Apply».
+ → «Say it»: «coffee 85», «mono 100 groceries», «yesterday cash 1 200 transport» — and it is recorded. What the phone cannot read, the AI finishes (Premium).
Say «Record in Dibsly» to Siri (Siri takes it in English only) or put the «Record in Dibsly» shortcut on the Action button. Step by step: Settings → Features → «Voice entry».
+ → «Receipt»: a photo or up to three screenshots — the items and the total fill in themselves. 10 receipts a month are free, up to 300 with Premium.
In a receipt, mark your items and send your friends their part by a link — each picks their own.

Every Apple Pay payment comes into Dibsly. When its account and category are already known, it is recorded by itself; the rest wait as drafts in Activity: check the amount and category and save with one tap. Free, with any card.
In Dibsly: Settings → Transaction automation → Apple Pay → «Install automation».
In Shortcuts, the Automation tab: «Dibsly · Apple Pay» should be on and run immediately, without asking.
Save each card's first payment with its account — Dibsly remembers it.
A payment in dollars on a hryvnia card is converted at the app's rate; tap the amount to enter what the bank charged. The statement later brings the exact amount.

A purchase with its account, amount and category, with nothing like it recorded yet, saves by itself, and Dibsly says «Saved ✅»; tap the notification to open the operation and change or delete it. A calendar payment with the same amount is marked paid. It is on for new users; after the update — Settings → Transaction automation → «Save at once». The same goes for bank notifications.

A new «Notification» automation from the Wallet app, «Run Immediately». Actions: «Get text» from Subtitle, Body and Title; «Text» with the two texts you got; then Dibsly's «Import Wallet notification»: Notification text — the text, Card — the card's name, «Show When Run» off.
Check that Wallet may show notifications: iOS Settings → Notifications → Wallet. If bank notifications are on too, one purchase still stays one draft.
Pushes from any bank — purchases, top-ups, transfers — are read by Dibsly with the AI through one Shortcuts automation and become drafts.
In Dibsly: Settings → Transaction automation → Bank notifications → «Install automation».
In Shortcuts, open «Dibsly · Bank Notifications» and under «When I receive a notification from» choose your banks' apps: monobank, Privat24, UKRSIB online, KredoBank or any other.
The automation should run immediately, and in «Read bank notification» turn off «Show When Run».
Allow Dibsly's AI when it asks: without it the notifications can't be read.
The first payment of each card asks for its account. A complete draft with its account and category saves by itself when

Settings → Import & export → «Connect monobank directly» → «Connect monobank», and confirm the access in the mono app. Dibsly names your cards and jars itself — check the names on «Here are your accounts», choose how much history to load, and from then on transactions arrive on their own within a minute. Read-only access, no token, no passwords; disconnect in the same place.
Save a statement in your bank's app: PDF, CSV, XLS or XLSX. «How to export» in Dibsly shows where to get one.
Share it to Dibsly or open Settings → Import & export → «Bank statement» — Dibsly recognises a FOP statement by itself.
Check the preview — the account, the number of operations, transfers between your accounts — and tap «Add to Dibsly» on «Here are your accounts».

Dibsly reads the statements of monobank, PrivatBank, UKRSIBBANK and KredoBank, and the FOP statements of PrivatBank and UKRSIBBANK, by itself, free. Any other bank is read by the AI: 3 statements in all free, up to 25 a month with Premium. Check the amounts of such a statement.
Importing the same period again adds only new operations, and the balance check compares your balance with the bank's.

Transfers between your accounts are recognised; an account money often goes to is offered as yours («Is this your account?»). Categories come from your history, your rules and the bank; the rest lands in «Uncategorized».
When recording an expense, open the category and switch to Brands: a tap writes the brand's name and picks your category for it.
Type the beginning of a name in the note and the brand comes once per category you used it with. Hold a brand on the Brands tab for its other categories.
A brand goes where most of your operations with it went, and the note keeps your own way of writing it. One different category once does not change it.
Rename an operation — «Heater» instead of «Rozetka» — and the brand stays, with its logo and category.
Settings → Brands: tap a brand and pick a category. It always goes there then, from statements and drafts too, and travels with backups, sync and the CSV export.
Payments you expect: subscriptions, rent, one-off reminders. They don't change the balance until you record or link an expense.
Open a payment: «Record expense» writes it, «Link» attaches an expense you already have. A draft that matches a payment offers «Mark as paid».

A charge from monobank (its sync or a push) or from a statement marks its payment in the calendar paid when it comes within three days: the same brand from any account and for any amount; the same name on the payment's account within ±10 %; an income for the exact amount. If the amount differs, the next payments take the new one. The “Paid in the calendar” message has Undo. An expense you record by hand you link yourself.

On the day or 1, 3 or 7 days before. «Add to calendar» in an expense creates a new payment. The calendar can be turned off in Settings, section Features; what Dibsly reminds you of is in Settings → Notifications.
Settings, section Features → Planning. Turning it off keeps your plans.
One plan a month in your main currency. Tap a category to set its limit; the page shows what's left and about how much you can spend a day.
When a category has payments from the

this month, «By the calendar …» under it shows their sum. Hold the category → «Use the calendar», and the limit becomes that sum. The limit card in Planning and Analytics shows the fact «By the calendar», and a new plan sets a limit no lower than the calendar.
The Plan card shows what's left and up to four categories you watch. Orange means 90% used, red — over the limit.
In the plan editor tap a category's name: you see each expense of last month and so far this month, so a limit starts from what really went out.
Hold a category for last month's amount or Remove limit; the bin next to the eye removes a limit in one tap, and the eye shows the category on Main. Hide the keypad with its ⌄ key or a swipe down.
What you save for: a flat, a car, a cushion. The money stays on savings and investment accounts; the goal shows how much of it is already its.
Turn Goals on in Settings, section Features. Then «Goals» on Main → «Add goal»: the amount, the date and the accounts.
«Goals’ order» decides which goal fills first. A goal of the Reserve kind (a cushion) always fills first and stays at the bottom.
The easiest way is to connect
: trades, dividends, deposits and currency exchanges come by themselves, and Investments turn on by themselves with the first connection. Or use a broker's report:
Settings → Features → Investments → «Turn on Investments». An Investments tile appears on Main — it opens your portfolio.
Save your broker's report: Interactive Brokers — the Activity Statement, Freedom Finance — the broker report as XLSX or PDF.
Open Settings → Import & export → «Broker report» and pick the file. Dibsly sorts out buys, sales, dividends with the tax withheld, and deposits.
A buy, a sale or a dividend can be recorded by hand too, and a broker's report added from the same place: «+» on the portfolio's page.

Connect it once, and new trades, dividends with their tax, commissions, deposits and currency exchanges arrive by themselves once a day, when you open Investments, in every currency. While connecting, Dibsly also loads the whole history IBKR keeps (usually this year and the four before), and later from any day: «Load the history from…» on the connection page. Steps 1–3 are easiest on a computer.
In IBKR's Client Portal: Performance & Reports → Flex Queries → Activity Flex Query → «+».
Add the sections Trades (Execution), Cash Transactions, Open Positions and Cash Report, all fields in each. Format XML, period Last 365 Calendar Days. Save it and note its number (Query ID).
On the same page, the gear of Flex Web Service Configuration: tick Flex Web Service Status and tap Save — a Current Token appears. Copy it.
In Dibsly: Investments → «+» → «Connect a broker» (or Settings → Investments → «Brokers, automatically») → Interactive Brokers. Paste the token and the query number → «Connect».

Dollars go to your Interactive dollar account, euros to the euro one; if there is no such account, Dibsly makes it. Deposits and currency conversions come too; what you already recorded as a transfer is not doubled. Update any time: «+» → «Update from the broker»; with two brokers connected it has a row for each, and each one updates on its own.
Such an operation's card says «Automatically from Interactive Brokers». If a broker stops accepting the key, Investments shows «… no longer accepts the key» with «Connect again».
It cannot trade, withdraw money or change the account's settings — that is how IBKR's Flex Web Service works.
The token stays on your device.
It sits in the device's Keychain and goes only to IBKR; it never reaches Dibsly's server.
We don't keep the account number.
Dibsly takes only its last 4 digits from the report, to tell operations apart.
«Disconnect» in Dibsly erases the token from the device at once; the operations stay. You can also switch Flex Web Service off or issue a new token in IBKR.
IBKR sets how long it lasts.
A token lasts up to a year; when it ends, Dibsly asks for a new one.
The same for Freedom24: one key, and new trades, dividends with their tax, commissions, deposits and currency exchanges come by themselves. Steps 1–4 are easiest on a computer.
On a computer, sign in to Freedom24 and open the API key page:
Leave the key's validity «Perpetual» and tap «Create a new key pair».
Freedom asks to open a security session: in the Freedom24 app on your phone open «Menu» → the icon at the top right and scan the QR code on the screen.
Copy the public key (32 characters). The private one isn't needed — don't paste it anywhere.
In Dibsly: Investments → «+» → «Connect a broker» → Freedom Finance. Paste the e-mail you sign in to Freedom24 with and the public key → «Connect».
Currencies go to your Freedom accounts just as with Interactive, and transfers you already recorded are not doubled. Update any time: «+» → «Update from the broker».
The public key only opens the report.
It cannot trade or withdraw money — that takes the private key, which Dibsly never asks for.
The key stays on your device.
It sits in the device's Keychain and goes only to Freedom24; it never reaches Dibsly's server.
«Disconnect» in Dibsly erases the key from the device at once; to close the access for good, delete the key pair on the same Freedom24 page.
You choose how long it lasts.
When you create the key in Freedom24: an empty field means no expiry.
What to pay in Ukraine on dividends and sales at foreign brokers, and what goes into the declaration. Free.
Investments → the «Taxes for 2026» tile. The taxes page shows each year apart.

The first time, Dibsly asks where your brokers are: for a foreign one Dibsly counts the taxes; a Ukrainian one withholds them itself, so Dibsly leaves it out. The US tax authority's certificate and the loss from past years go in «Tax settings».
Paid? Record the expense in the «Investment taxes» category and Dibsly finds the payment itself. Filed the declaration? «Filed?» → «Filed».

Every dividend and sale in hryvnias at the NBU rate of its day. Dividends: PIT 9 % and the military levy 5 %; the tax withheld abroad reduces PIT only with the US tax authority's certificate. Sales: 18 % and 5 % of the profit in hryvnias — the proceeds at the sale day's rate less the purchase at the purchase day's rate and the commissions. A loss is carried to the next years.

Dividends — line 10.10, investment profit — line 10.8 and annex Ф1, and how much PIT and military levy to pay. The declaration is due by 1 May, the payment by 1 August; Dibsly reminds you on 24 April and 24 July.
On Investments, under the profit — «After taxes, if sold today»: what would be left if you sold everything now. And the «Investment taxes» category also gathers every tax a broker withheld.
With Premium the same page is on
It's a calculation for the declaration, not tax advice: Dibsly doesn't pay taxes or file the declaration. Check the figures in the tax service's online office.

Who owes whom and how much. Lent, borrowed or paid back is a transfer between your account and the person, so it is neither an expense nor an income. Dibsly only records it: you move the money yourself.
Main → Debts at the bottom, or + → Operation → Debt.
In an expense's card, «Split with…»: your part stays an expense, your friends' parts become debts. For a receipt: «Split the bill» with «I paid the whole bill».
On the person's page, «Paid back» or «Pay back». Money from them in a bank notification is suggested as a return; a saved income becomes one with «It is a debt paid back» in its card.

Until a friend accepts the debt, «Share» sends them its link: a friend with Dibsly accepts it in their app, and every record either of you makes reaches the other to confirm. Then «Remind» sends them a push. You both need a Dibsly account — a free one is enough.
«Paid back» → «Money did not come to an account»: the debt closes and the sum goes to Gifts in your expenses.
A loan, a mortgage, instalments, a microloan or a card's limit: what's left, the next payment and the overpayment.
Turn on «Credits» in Settings, section Features: the Credits block appears at the bottom of Main. «All ›» in it → «+» → the kind. A mortgage or an old loan is entered by what is left on a day.
In a saved expense's card, «Bought in instalments»: the purchase stays whole in Analytics, the bank's part comes back to the card, and each month's part pays the instalment off.

On a credit's page, «Pay» splits the payment into the body and interest (an expense in «Interest and fees»). «Early» shows what a shorter term or a lower payment saves. A payment from a statement: «This is a credit payment» in its card.
«On hand» shows only your own money, with «… of credit still available» under it. Payments show in the calendar with reminders three days before and on the day.
Dibsly only records the payments — it never moves the bank's money.
For a 3rd-group FOP (5%, no VAT): income, the single tax, the military levy and ESV by quarter, deadlines and payment details. Free.
Settings, section Features → FOP → «Turn on FOP». A short questionnaire: the group, the rate, ESV, your community, the FOP accounts.
Income on a FOP account counts at the NBU rate of the day it arrived. A refund or your own transfer: turn off «FOP income» in the operation's card, or hold it on the FOP page → «Not income».
The FOP page shows the single tax, the military levy and ESV by quarter, how much is due and by when. The deadlines are in the calendar with reminders.
«Show payment details» under the deadlines opens the amounts and the tax service's details for your community — every field copies with a tap.
Hours, rate and your own conditions — and how much should arrive each month. You type the hours each month on the FOP page.
Dibsly doesn't pay taxes or file returns — you do. Check the figures and details against the tax service's e-cabinet, especially before your first payment.
A chat about your money right in the app: ask in words, Dibsly answers in your own figures.
On Main — the button above «+»; on other pages — the orange tab on the right. The chat knows which page you opened it from.
It counts spending, finds operations, records («record coffee 85»), moves them to categories, sets limits and imports a statement with 📎. Nothing is saved until you tap «Save».

Ask about the app itself too: «how do trends in Analytics work?», «how are investment taxes counted?» — Dibsly answers from its own guide, so it explains how the app really works. Such a question goes to the AI and is counted like the others.
«Where do I turn on FOP?» or «how do I hide the amounts» — Dibsly answers itself from the help, without the AI and not counted. «Ask the AI» under such an answer asks the AI.

20 questions to the AI a month are free, up to 40 a day with Premium. The first time, Dibsly shows what goes to the AI and asks for your permission; to turn the chat on or off — Settings → Features → «AI in Dibsly» → «Ask Dibsly». The conversation stays on this device; «Clear conversation» is there too.
Profile (the circle next to the gear) → sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail. Without an account everything works on one device.
With Premium your data is the same on all your iPhones, iPads and on my.dibslyapp.com.
67 animated Dibsly. They open as you set things up — accounts, a backup, automation — and keep good habits, and there are memes, secrets and holidays too. Free.
Profile (the circle next to the gear) → «My Dibsly»: your level, «Next» — whom to open next, and the sections Setup, Habits, Memes, Secrets and Holidays. Tap a closed Dibsly to see what opens it.
arrives as a toast with confetti right on the screen where you opened it; «View» shows its page.
On a Dibsly's page, «Make it my avatar», and it appears in the circle on Main instead of your photo. «Back to the photo» undoes it.
— a 9:16 picture of your Dibsly for Stories or a messenger.
With sync, the Dibsly you opened and your avatar are the same on all your iPhones and iPads.

The same Dibsly: install it from the App Store on your iPad and sign in to the same account — with sync the data is the same as on your iPhone. Premium from the same Apple Account works on the iPad too.

A sidebar on the left: Main, History, Analytics and Main's pages. Main in two columns, tiles and charts across the screen. A bar at the bottom: type “coffee 85” and press Return to record it, or a question to open the chat with Dibsly; the microphone, the camera and “+” beside it. Upright or in Split View you get the tabs at the bottom, as on iPhone.
⌘N a new expense, ⇧⌘N an income, ⌘F search History, ⌘1–⌘3 Main, History, Analytics. Hold ⌘ and the iPad lists them.
Apple Pay and bank notifications are set up on the iPhone, where payments and banks' pushes arrive. With sync those operations are on the iPad at once.

On hand — the total, the rates, the credit available, your accounts and the Savings, Investments and FOP tiles, as on Main. Next payment — the nearest payments from the calendar. Quick entry — an expense, voice or a receipt in one tap. On the Lock Screen — On hand and a “+” for an expense. Free, on iPhone and iPad.
Touch and hold an empty spot on the Home Screen → Edit → Add Widget → Dibsly, and pick a size. On the Lock Screen: touch and hold → Customize → Lock Screen → the widgets area → Dibsly.

Hide amounts hides them in the widgets too, and a locked screen keeps them hidden. A widget shows what Dibsly saved for it on your device — nothing goes out. It updates when you open Dibsly; the total and the accounts also after a sync or a monobank operation in the background.
Settings → Preferences → App icon: System — light on a light Home Screen and dark on a dark one — Dark or Light. iOS shows its own message that the icon changed.
Sign in to your Dibsly account: Profile → Apple, Google or e-mail.
Profile → «Sharing» → «Invite by link» and send the link.
The other person opens it on an iPhone or iPad with Dibsly and taps «Join». To share an account, open its card (Settings → Accounts) → «Make shared».
Shared accounts and goals: each sees their own and the shared. One member's Premium is enough; anyone can leave there any time.

on a computer and sign in to the same Dibsly account as in the app. History with search and drafts, analytics, accounts, debts and credits, the plan, the calendar, goals, investments with their taxes, FOP and the «Ask Dibsly» chat are there; changes show up in the app at once.

Each year apart: the taxes on dividends and sales, what is already paid and with what, what is left and the declaration's lines. The «paid» and «filed» marks and the tax settings are the same as in the app.
In History open an expense → «Split by category», as in the app.
On the website open «Connect AI»: it has the connection address
and the steps for each assistant.
(claude.ai, the app): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector with the address above, sign in to Dibsly and allow access.
and connect it; sign in to Dibsly the same way and allow access. On some ChatGPT plans it can only read — that's the plan's limit, not Dibsly's.

Ask in words: «how much did I spend on cafés this month?», «here is a statement, add it», «how much tax do I owe on last year's dividends?» — the assistant sees investment taxes too, with the same figures as the app. The assistant writes changes only after your «yes», and each can be undone in the AI journal on the website.
All connections are in the app: Profile → «Devices and AI». You can remove them there.

Dibsly imports a Monefy CSV and its own CSV. In Monefy export your data as CSV, then in Dibsly: Settings → Import & export → «CSV file» → «Monefy CSV». Accounts, categories, currencies and transfers come over, and Dibsly shows exactly what it will add before saving.

Export your data as CSV or Excel, then «CSV file» → «Other app». Dibsly's AI works out from a sample of rows where the date, amount, category and account are, and Dibsly reads every row on your device. Before saving you see what will be added and how many rows were left out. This import only adds operations and never replaces anything, and the same file a second time doubles nothing.
A Dibsly or Monefy CSV can be added to your data or replace it all — then a safety copy is made first.
Settings → Backup & recovery: choose an iCloud Drive folder or connect Google Drive, make up a recovery password and turn on automatic backups.
Keep the password in a password manager: without it a backup can't be opened, and nobody, Dibsly included, can recover it.
Automatic backups run daily or weekly, usually at night; the last five are kept, manual ones are never deleted.

«Open a backup file» restores any .dibslybackup. On a new iPhone or iPad, tap «Restore your data» on Dibsly's first screen, or just sign in if you have sync (Premium). A safety copy of the current data is made first.
A backup holds everything, drafts and most settings included. A CSV holds operations, accounts, plans and the calendar, but no drafts or settings.

Settings → Data health → «Delete all data». Dibsly first keeps a safety copy on this device and leaves your iCloud Drive and Google Drive backups alone. When you are signed in, the button isn't there — see below.

Profile → «Delete account and all data»: the server deletes everything in the account and this device is erased. «Save a copy first» makes a backup. Deleting doesn't cancel Premium — cancel it in iOS Settings.
Profile → «Remove from this device» (with sync): your data stays in the account and the device is erased. Without sync the button reads «Sign out», and the data stays on the device.

Without an account your records stay only on this device and in your own backups. monobank, PrivatBank, UKRSIBBANK and KredoBank statements are read here; another bank's statement or another app's export is read by the AI, only with your permission.

An account and sync (Premium) keep your data on Dibsly's server. The AI works only with your consent: what an answer needs goes to OpenAI through Dibsly's server. Also NBU rates, investment quotes, monobank, connected brokers (straight from your device, the key kept only in its Keychain), your backups in iCloud or Google Drive, and anonymous usage statistics you can turn off in Preferences.
«Hide amounts» shows •••• instead of sums, and App Lock asks for Face ID when you come back. Notifications still show amounts — hide previews in iOS Settings.
All the details are in the

Premium — $2.99 a month or $29.99 a year — adds sync and shared accounts, the website, ChatGPT and Claude, notifications from any bank, AI categories and import from any other app. The limits are higher: up to 300 receipts a month (10 without Premium), up to 25 statements of other banks a month (3 in all without Premium) and up to 40 chat questions a day (20 a month without Premium).
iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions → Dibsly, at least 24 hours before the period ends. When Premium ends, nothing is deleted.
